mechanism: Doxycycline may increase photosensitivity risk when combined with chlorpromazine, which is also a photosensitizing agent; additionally, chlorpromazine may reduce doxycycline absorption through anticholinergic effects and gastric pH changes.
action: Monitor for photosensitivity reactions; counsel patients to avoid excessive sun exposure and use protective measures; consider alternative antibiotics if severe photosensitivity risk is a concern.
